posts.title: How much a token cost
posts.description: I've been thinking about a better way to calculate ROI on LLMs, and needless to say that I started to think that tokens are the wrong unit we should be measuring, for the simple reason that a "smarter" LLM should get you to the same outcome with fewer turns (and perhaps also tokens) required.
